title: Assata & Saddam: a Tale of 2 Revolutions

sense.text:
This is the marketplace in New Guinea, the people with “cuttings in their flesh”. Some of you got those marks. God says you don’t do that either: that’s a sin. A tattoo is a sin. Look at some of the brothers here before they repented, some of them got it. But repentance is you don’t do it no more. We don’t do it no more.

Out in that market our people were told that God shall set his hand a second time. The first time, we the Israelites were delivered out of the land of Egypt, the history of Moses delivering the children of Israel out of Egypt. That is reading the history of your fathers and mothers; this is the second time.

This was the park in New Guinea, where the people gather under the trees to worship; we went there and disturbed their worship, and the pastor came later with a gang of thugs to attack us, and the Most High delivered us. To the New Guineans: God said in the last days he will call you his people, because he’s going to bring you back to who you were originally, “and her beloved, which was not beloved.”

“In the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people”: here in Papua New Guinea, where it was said unto them, you’re not God’s people, you’re Papua New Guineans. That’s what they say. “There shall they be called the children of the living God.” That’s who you are, the children of the Living God.

In the Solomon Islands we addressed the New York Times article, that the Pacific is a dumping ground for priests accused or convicted of abuse: Catholic priests and missionaries moved to remote island nations after they had abused children in the west, their superiors shielding them. Little did we know the Catholic church has power on the Solomon Islands. We blasted the church, and the very next day, when we went out to teach, the city council’s men came and put their hands on us, pushing us and telling us to stop teaching the Bible. They never identified themselves; the Catholic church has power over them and they got the phone call. They don’t want us teaching that the religions our people have been learning are false, that we have too long learned the Bible from the mouth of the white man, the European man.

“When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people”: when the Israelites, our people, went from one nation to the next nation in captivity.
“He suffered no man to do them wrong”: he suffered no man to do us wrong. “Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes”: he reproved kings for our sake.

“Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.” They going to learn, cuz the Most High going to bring judgment on them if they don’t repent: fire and brimstone. They tried to get us on immigration charges after that, and the Sabbath class there had to be cancelled.

One brother, Sammy, was so distraught the Sabbath class was cancelled that he followed us to the hotel and said he wanted to learn. “That shall rule my people”: who his people is. That’s why we went to Matthew 2:6.

precepts.why: Go back to Isaiah chapter 9. “Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end.” What word do we see in verse seven that we just saw in Matthew 2:6? Government. The Governor that shall rule my people is Jesus; and who is he going to be the governor of? His people, Israel. That brother was happy.

sense.text: We all familiar with this. “Of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to”: this is talking about King David. I bought the New Living Translation Bible for that one verse, and in verse 12 it reads, ‘he was dark and handsome, with beautiful eyes.’ You see how they translated ruddy: dark. So they know. Don’t you think the scholars know King David and the Hebrews were dark-skinned people? They know; they play games with words. So when we say King David is black, we know exactly what we talking about. He wasn’t red, he was dark.

The real Jingle Bells was not about bells, it’s about slaves escaping. The original was named ‘One Horse Open Sleigh’, first performed in blackface in a minstrel show in Boston in 1847, the shows where white people dressed up like black people and pretended they were stupid and lazy, and that was funny to them. If you was a runaway they put that yoke on you with the bells on it, so they can hear you when you trying to run away.

“And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry”: when we fell and went into captivity, they rejoiced over our fall and made merry. That’s Merry Christmas. Christmas has racist origins, based upon them celebrating our enslavement and destruction.

“And shall send gifts one to another”: we were the gifts. Our sons and daughters were the gifts. In Birth of a Nation, Nat Turner sees a black woman and says to his owner she would be a good gift for his sister, cuz her birthday is coming up. We were always the gifts.

“Because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth”: these two prophets mean these two nations, Judah and Ephraim. We tormented them because we dominated them, we ruled them. The white scholars know the history; it’s our people in Christianity that don’t know the real history.

precepts.why:
Still talking about the damn Christmas: all the white man’s holidays are about oppression to our people. “But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not”.

“With hypocritical mockers in feasts”: all their feast days are to our detriment. “They gnashed upon me with their teeth”: they got these secret meanings behind it.

In the Solomon Islands it’s 95 degrees nonstop, and they celebrate Christmas as the birth of Jesus. The parents bring all their kids to sit at the tree, like Rockefeller Center in New York City, to worship for blessings from the white image of Jesus. That tree is an idol.

sense.text:
The book 100 Films from Cinema’s Greatest Year, on 1971: in the original novel the Oompa Loompas were black pygmies imported by Wonka from the African jungle to work in his factory. A delegation of black actors raised concerns, and they were given orange faces and green hair. Then one of them asked, you know who Mr Charlie is: the name the black workers used to call their white supervisors on the old plantations. So it became Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory.

“I am as one mocked of his neighbour”: we are always mocked by this white man. The Bible prophesied that because of our sins we would always be mocked. And believe me, the white man knew what Mr Charlie meant; they always play stupid.

“The just upright man is laughed to scorn”: the just upright man, which is us, is laughed to scorn.

precepts.why:
“Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things”: grievous things, mocking us, “proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.” It’s always against us, the righteous.

“Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee”. “Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man”: the Lord shall hide us in the secret of his presence.

“Thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues”: that’s when them chariots come in and destruction hits this place. Everybody’s going bye bye, Adam: ashes to ashes and dust to dust. That pavilion is the Lord’s chariots.

sense.text:
Today is a tale of two revolutions, Assata Shakur and Saddam Hussein, and it correlates to us today. Assata Shakur worked with the Black Liberation Army for the liberation of black people; she got arrested, and her brothers in the Black Liberation Army went to the prison and broke her out. The black man saved the black woman. On November 2nd, 1979 she escaped, lived underground, and the brothers transported her to Cuba in 1984. She changed her name to get rid of the slave name, and they still will not respect it; that’s more of the mockery.

She said, ‘It is our duty to fight for our freedom. It is our duty to win.’ And the Bible says we going to win. ‘We must love and protect one another.’ How many black women think like that today? ‘I’mma do me,’ it’s me, me, me. Brothers, if you are not married, you want a woman who thinks like that, not the American ‘I need this and I need that.’ That is like a Judith, a Deborah: she loved her people and she stands for her people. Ask the right questions when you court her, see if she’s about that business.

‘We have nothing to lose but our chains.’ Some of these women thinking, I ain’t got no chains on me. “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness”: your enemies would control the imports and exports of water, food and clothing. “And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” So when did those yokes of iron come off? Until he have destroyed thee.

That’s the chains she was talking about, as in the book by Carter G. Woodson: the chains ain’t on your neck no more, it’s on your mind. You American black woman feminist, ‘I am woman hear me roar’, ‘I don’t need a man’, ‘I could do bad by myself’, ‘I’m an independent’, ‘my body my choice’: those are the chains. All we got to lose is our chains.

She said it is our duty to fight for our freedom. The Maccabees said, “But we fight for our lives and our laws.” Remember, she didn’t know the Bible; she was not into the scriptures at all. In that time period they wasn’t dealing with the word of God, but they knew about revolution to a degree, something that has been lost by generations today: ‘huh, I can’t spell revolution.’

Everybody want to know when should the kingdom of God come. “The kingdom of God cometh not with observation”: it doesn’t come with eye service. Brothers and sisters, I’m just going to sit here and look, that’s going to make the kingdom come? No, it’s not.

“For, behold, the kingdom of God is within you”: you got to bring that thing out. You got to bring out the fruits of the spirit; you got to set that example to show men, women, children, boys and girls how to live, how to act, the laws to live by. That’s how we help bring out the kingdom of God: through our example, through our lives. Many people don’t understand that.

We always read this, we read it quite a lot while we were away, and brothers always pull it. It’s a good scripture, don’t get me wrong. “And the truth shall make you free”: free from what? What is Christ talking about? Read down and get the context.

“We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man”: they understood being set free means free from bondage. You hear the church quote this scripture and not understand it’s talking about being set free from bondage; they don’t even acknowledge they’re in bondage, like these do.

Watch what these dumb Pharisees say. That was a lie, because Rome was dominating Jerusalem and enforced taxation on the Israelites. These were the rich; these rich dudes were saying, I’ve never been in bondage, I’m free. Just like Jason Whitlock: ‘I’m a multi-millionaire, I’m not in bondage, I am free.’ That’s how the rich of our people think: they think they are free.

“Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.” What does sin cause, brothers? Bondage, slavery, oppression. That’s what Christ was trying to tell them, and the Pharisees could not understand it. Even if you’re not one of those super rich multi-millionaires, we’ve met men and women with well to-do jobs, 200,000, 300,000 a year, and they go, I’m good, I’m not in bondage. Are you kidding me? That’s why they got to know the truth, so the truth can set them free.
Watch what Christ said about that. “They that received tribute money”: tribute money is taxes. “Doth not your master pay tribute?” Does your master not pay taxes?

“Of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?” Who does Rome collect taxes from: of their own people, or of strange nations, meaning other nations?

“Of strangers”: other nations. Rome was collecting taxes from other nations. “Then are the children free.” When you are collecting taxes, that’s when you’re free. As long as you’re paying another nation taxes you’re not free; you’re subject to their rules, their guidelines, their policies.

precepts.why:
This is what “Then are the children free” means. “The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet”: everybody that hates us is going to bow down at the soles of our feet. “And they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel”: that’s what we’re going to be called.

“Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated”: we were forsaken of all nations, hated of all nations. “So that no man went through thee”: no man took care of us, no nation looked after us. “I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations”: God is going to make us, the Israelites, an eternal excellency and a joy of many generations.

“Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings”: the milk of the Gentiles means their wealth. Everything’s going to come back to us. “For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver”: this is the wealth he’s going to give us.

“I will also make thy officers peace”: y’all think officers is something new; no, that’s all from the Bible. The ranking is going to be set up in the Kingdom too. “And thine exactors righteousness”: an exactor is a tax collector. We going to be the new tax collectors on the earth; all nations going to bring us taxes. That’s what Christ was talking about in Matthew 17: then are the children free. When you’re collecting taxes, that’s when you know you’re free; as long as you’re paying taxes, you’re not free.

sense.text:
Assata Shakur said, ‘No one is going to give you the education you need to overthrow them. Nobody is going to teach you your true history, teach you your true heroes, if they know that that knowledge will help set you free.’ Sisters, get your minds right: your oppressor is not going to give you the tools or education to overthrow them. They’re going to give you Mary had a little lamb, whose fleece was white as snow; Atlanta Housewives, Basketball Wives, all the stupid things that keep you in the utter cup of stupidity. It’s up to you to come up out of that bowl of stupidity and get into the Bible. You think they’re going to teach us that at one time we ruled them for a thousand years in Europe? Stop being a damn fool. Martin Luther King Jr is not one of the true heroes; the true heroes are Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Moses, Christ, Peter, James, Paul.

“Arise, shine”: brothers, arise means wake up, and shine means teach. Once you’ve woken up, teach what you’ve learned. “For thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.”

“For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth”: the darkness means sin, lies. That’s why Assata Shakur said nobody’s going to teach you your true history: we’re in darkness. “And gross darkness the people”: our race, our people, are in the worst darkness of all time. The other nations can go back in their history somewhat, centuries. Blacks and Latinos can’t; we can only go up to where the white man entered and conquered us, and before that it’s, I’m not too sure. That’s why we must go back to what the Bible says; this is the history we must come back to. “But the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.”

Still dealing with what Assata Shakur said: no one’s going to give you the education you need to overthrow them, nobody’s going to teach you your true history or your true heroes. “And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world”: that’s a metaphor for the white man deceiving the whole world. That’s their job.

They’re not going to give us our true history or our true heroes. They look throughout Hollywood for those little actors, entertainers and basketball players: these are your heroes, your leaders. No, they’re not. Even Malcolm X said these are buffoons, these are clowns: where in the white or Chinese community do you see comedians as a leader? They only do that with black and brown people, because they say they’re stupid, they’ll go for it.

precepts.why:
“But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not”. All the people that got such bright ideas with economics and all that crap, like it’s never been thought of before: Satan, this white man, has blinded their minds. They can’t see what the Bible’s talking about.

Where did black economics get Black Wall Street or Rosewood? We got bombed to hell and back. As soon as black people started doing good, the white man said they’re doing better than us; accuse them of rape, let’s bomb, let’s kill everybody. It happened city after city, and here we are in 2024 and a negro got a bright idea, economics is the way, put our money together and it’s going to save us. They paid celebrities millions to convince the negro to vote, because that’s how low they look at us.

“Lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.” That’s the only thing that can shine and set us free: the knowledge of God, the knowledge of Christ, the knowledge of this Bible.

sense.text:
Still dealing with what sister Assata Shakur said: if they know you’re gonna use that knowledge to overthrow them, they’re not going to teach you. That’s why they gave you a white Jesus. They’re not going to tell you that the Son of God looks like you. When we travel, it’s always women asking, how come the white man never taught us that?

“Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.” All these people get their theology degree from their oppressor; they have colonialism theocracy, and that’s what they teach. A senator who is also a pastor: these guys get their theology degrees, their doctorates, from the same man that destroyed their people, and they think they have the truth of the Bible.

Assata Shakur said, ‘The less you think about your oppression, the more your tolerance for it grows. After a while people just think oppression is the normal state of things.’ That’s why you hear people say I’m not oppressed: it’s become normal to them. It’s not normal for a black race to pray to a white God. Paying taxes and all these bills is not normal. ‘But to become free you have to be acutely aware of being a slave’: that’s what Christ was trying to tell the scribes and Pharisees. In order to be free you got to know exactly what’s going on, your state of being, your state of mind. Our people forget Sonya Massey, Breonna Taylor, Sandra Bland, Eric Garner, Michael Brown: upset for one day, maybe a week, then back to work, the game is on. White people don’t forget; they bring up OJ every chance they get. This has become normal to us.

John Henry Clarke didn’t know the scriptures either, but he said freedom is something you take with your own hands, and ‘we stand begging at the door of people who reduced us to beggars.’

“He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill”: we’re the beggar he’s going to lift out. He’s saying we living in the dunghill. Our people have a nice house and go, I don’t live in a dunghill. You were reduced from ruling nations and countries to living in a house. You might even have a mansion; it’s still not comparable to where you came from. It’s a dunghill, and you got to pay property tax on it, this tax and that tax. Set your mind free.

Why does he call us a beggar? Cuz we always got a hand out. Can I have a job, can I have a raise, can I have this day off, Mr white man; can I have public assistance, can I have food stamps, can I have an education. We are the beggar. You might not see this as begging, but that’s what God says it is. We have fallen from being kings and priests, and now we got our hand out: help me, somebody help me. We are Lazarus that Christ spoke about at the rich man’s table.

When was the last time you saw these rich people, like a LeBron James, stand up for the black community? When something goes wrong they don’t say nothing; they under contract: we pay you good, don’t say a word, shut up and dribble.

This is what Christ was saying, what John Henry Clarke was saying, what sister Assata Shakur was saying. “And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness”: that’s us. “And thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.” That’s why the only savior is Jesus the Christ, the black Messiah. So we must come back to what this book says.

“Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies”: we’ve been delivered into the hands of our enemies. Just like in the past, we’re still here today. “Who vexed them”: vexation is constant oppression. We are vexed.

“And according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours”: that’s who you brothers be. You are saviors, “who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.” That’s what preaching the Bible is all about. We can’t physically do it, but in the spirit realm we are doing it, because it’s going to usher in the second coming of Christ.

“Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us”: everything, brothers and sisters, that God has brought upon us, what Deuteronomy 28 and Leviticus 26 say would happen to us, God is justified. “For thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly”: everything God does is right, and what we’ve done has been nothing but wicked.

“Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law”: none of our ancestors was keeping the law. When the kingdom was split we got worse and worse, more sinful and more sinful. So you got booty shaking and twerking and LGBT now.
“Behold, we are servants this day”: this is what Assata Shakur was saying. “Behold, we are servants in it”: we are servants in the land.

“And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins”: the kings that he has set over us are like Biden, or Trump, or whoever the president is, because of our sins. “Also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.”

Nehemiah understood. That’s what Assata Shakur said: to be free you have to be acutely aware of being a slave. You might say in your ignorance they don’t have power over my body. When the white man said put that mask on, everybody put that mask on; six feet. And some of you go vote for Kamala because you want to kill your babies. They have power over you.

Assata Shakur said, ‘We need to be weapons of mass construction, weapons of mass love. It’s not enough just to change the system, we need to change ourselves.’ It is impossible to change the system. Some of our people go into politics with the right intention, to help the black community, but you got to know what realm you’re stepping into. You think the white man murdered millions of our people to have one ignorant negro walk up in there and change everything, to snatch the government from him? He’s not that stupid.

“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood”: this ain’t a physical fight that we can win, brothers. “But against principalities”: we are fighting a spiritual fight, “against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world.” That word rulers translates to governments.

“Against spiritual wickedness in high places”: it don’t matter who’s in the seat, it’s the spirit in the seat. It don’t matter who the president is; the spirit that comes with that seat is going to take over that man or that woman. God’s program is going to get done: tribulation will still come, the prophecies will still come to pass, evil will escalate. You say I’m going in there to change things; you get sworn in and a spirit comes on you, and you’re like, I don’t know why I’m acting like this, I had good intentions, but now you’re the devil. Like those African presidents, monkey paws: they used a black woman to veto every time they wanted a ceasefire in Gaza. All the countries say ceasefire, and that big monkey King Kong paw went up. It’s not by accident they send a black woman: ‘yes boss, I got you boss.’

We need to be weapons of mass construction: construction starts first in your mind, in your spirit. The mind and spirit must come first.

Assata Shakur said we need to be weapons of mass construction, and construction starts first in your mind and in your spirit. Changing yourself starts in your mind, and Christ said it: “Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.” In order to enter New Jerusalem on earth, the kingdom of heaven on earth, you must be converted like a little child.

You’re working on your outer man: you got your dress code together, you got your body the way you want it, the hourglass shape. But what about the inside? A sister can look pretty on the outside, and when she speaks it’s like the devil is talking to you, and all that beauty you don’t see no more. That’s the movie Shallow Hal: he saw the inner man, the inner woman. Everybody else saw a beautiful waitress, but her inside was so corrupt. I’m not saying don’t change your body or your physical outlook, that’s fine, but the inner man and the inner woman must be changed.

precepts.why:
What does it mean to be converted? “The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul”. The only thing that can convert your soul is God’s law. That is what your children should be doing and what you sisters should be doing, not playing video games, wasting your life, getting wrong information put in your spirit and your soul.

A story: a couple we knew years ago. At Christmas she bought him a leather coat and he bought her a book, and she cursed him out for it. Then they went to talk, and when he told her sure, in time, we’re working on it, she said that’s not what Jeff said: on the Edge of Night, you’re supposed to respond like that. That’s the mentality of a lot of sisters: if you don’t respond the way the TV guy said, there’s something wrong with you. Your mind is stuck on TV, sis; that’s not reality. Some of your wives want you to act and talk like the TV people do.

They watch Tyler Perry: the dark one is always the bad guy, the evil one, and you need a light-skinned brother to come save the woman: ‘get away from her, Blackie.’ All his movies are like that, and that’s why she says she wants a light-skinned brother. That’s colorism. So it’s good to change, but the soul gets converted by God’s law.

This goes with Matthew 18:3, where Christ said except you be converted as a little child you cannot enter the kingdom of heaven on earth. “Therefore if so be that ye will subdue your own understanding”: everything you learned from the age of five to the age you are now, forget about it. Subdue it, push it down, don’t meditate on it, get it out the way.

“And reform your hearts”: reform means change, transform; heart means mind. Transform your mind. “Ye shall be kept alive”: kept alive for the coming kingdom. “And after death ye shall obtain mercy”: after this body dies you shall obtain mercy, you’re going to get eternal life. That’s what the angel was telling Ezra.

It’s about changing your mind. “Have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him”. Start at verse eight: “But now ye also put off all these; anger”: we got to put that away. Wrath, “malice”: put that away. “Blasphemy”: put that away. “Filthy communication out of your mouth”: put that away, and yes, that includes twerking. “Lie not one to another”: we can’t do it.

“Seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds”. Our job, brothers and sisters, is to be transformed to the image of Christ, to follow the pattern of Christ to the best of our ability. There’s no such thing as a brother or a sister with a bad attitude and we say, oh, that’s just him, that’s just her. No, our job is to be changed into the image of Christ. You can’t stay an alcoholic: if you was an alcoholic, stop drinking. You cursing everybody out as soon as somebody tries to have a decent conversation: stop that.

sense.text:
Sisters, brothers, we got to let the women know: there is no revolution without the man. You women are not doing this on your own. We went into slavery together, and we’re going to be redeemed together. It ain’t ‘she’s going to get saved and we’re sitting back here in captivity.’ That’s not happening; the scripture says we are heirs together.

“A King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.” That’s what Christ is going to do. We have never seen justice. We on the street crying no justice, no peace. Where’s the justice for Mike Brown, for Kendrick Johnson, for Sonya Massey, for Breonna Taylor, for Sandra Bland? Where’s the justice for Rosewood, for Black Wall Street? We have never experienced true justice. But when Christ comes he’s going to execute judgment and justice in the earth, and that terrifies the nations, because the white man understands what it’s going to look like. We say Jesus is black and the white man already jumps back: ‘you saying I’m going into slavery.’ They already figured that out. Does it matter? It matters a whole lot: that means we’re going to get justice.
“In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.” Christ is the King.

“Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness”: the king is Christ. “And princes shall rule in judgment”: we are the princes. Isaiah 32:1 to 4 gives you the importance of the repented man, how important he is.

“And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind”: the wind represents tribulation, persecution, trials. Sisters, the man shall be as a hiding place: you’re going to get your help with your man. This is a prophecy, because this ain’t happened yet. “A covert from the tempest”: a protection from the storm, and those storms represent tribulations and trials. That’s how important a man is.

“As rivers of water in a dry place”: like in the John Wick movie where he was dying of thirst in the desert and she gave him some water. It was nasty water, but he drank it. In this dry land, which is America, the man is like a river of water: that means you need that man. All that feminism, ‘I don’t need no man, I got my own house, I got my own property,’ and then she goes, how come nobody wants me? Because men are not interested in what you have. A good man, a real man, don’t care what a sister has. All he wants is silence, a sandwich and sex: three S’s, see how easy that is? But some find that so difficult. And there will be a cleanup woman coming behind you: ‘I’ll do it for you, boo.’

“As the shadow of a great rock in a weary land”: a hot, weary land, and you’re looking for shade. God said the man is like that great rock in a weary place, shade over you so you can stay cooled off. God’s giving an analogy of how the man is.

“And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim”: the eyes of those men that see. In this society we grow up and our spiritual eyes are not open to what the Bible truly says, until now. This is still just the beginning. “And the ears of them that hear shall hearken”: spiritual ears that hear shall hearken, meaning obey what this Bible says.

“The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge”: the rash, that’s us. We’re always rash in our speech, rash in what we think. Now we’re understanding God’s laws, his knowledge: God says we got to live this way, eat this way, dress this way, deal like this with a woman.

“And the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.” We stammered in these different religions and philosophies out here, when we were Catholics, Muslims, Seventh-day Adventists, Jehovah’s Witnesses: God loves everybody, God’s going to forgive everybody for whatever, slavery too, everybody’s equal, the woman and the man is equal. Stupid stuff. Now when we speak this book we speak plainly: this is what the Bible’s really saying. Give me the word plain, make it easy to the listener.

“The vile person shall be no more called liberal”: the liberals are these Democrats. You got Republicans that are conservatives, but they’re somewhat liberal too. “Nor the churl said to be bountiful.”

Why is he saying that? Because from verse one down it’s telling you the importance of the Israelite man, and then he goes on to talk about how there’s a system set up, a vile system of liberals. Verses 5 to 8 talk about the liberals, because the black woman, the Israelite woman, has been trusting in the Democrats and Republicans, and it has destroyed her husband, destroyed her children, destroyed her life.

“For the vile person will speak villany”: evil. “And his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord”: they always contradict the Lord. “To make empty the soul of the hungry”: our people are the hungry. “And he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail”: the woman is the thirsty, she is the soul of the hungry. Remember verse two: a man shall be as rivers of water in a dry place. But the woman trusts in the liberals. He ain’t making our soul empty, because we know what the Bible says.

“The instruments also of the churl are evil”: the word churl means rude, and it’s still talking about the liberals. Their instruments are their programs, and the programs they set up are evil. “He deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right”: the needy is our people.

Their instruments, the liberal things, put on the screen so the women can relate: health care access, liberal policies like the Affordable Care Act to improve access for black Americans. Education equity, to close the achievement gap; you got the United Negro College Fund. Remember what Assata Shakur said: no one is going to give you the education you need to overthrow them, nobody is going to teach you your true history and your true heroes if they know that knowledge will help set you free. The white man says, we’ll give you a little liberty to teach your own children, and most black women say, I want you, Mr. white man, to teach my children. Damn. That’s why a lot of sisters got little Pooky and RayRay: you’ve inducted your children into the system of the man that hates your black gums, a system hellbent on destroying us, and you want to know why your daughter is twerking.

Affordable housing: a lot of it goes with single women. They divide the black man and the black woman, but so subtly you’re not going to see it: through education, welfare, the housing section. On a podcast a black man asked a black woman, would you prefer a black man working hard to get the family up, or the welfare? She said she’d prefer the welfare. A lot of them don’t want to go through the ups and downs of marriage. They think marriage is like TV, The Notebook, a make-believe love story, Cinderella, prince charming sweeping me off my feet and happily ever after. That ain’t reality. Every marriage has ups and downs. Read the Bible: every sister, married or not, read the Book of Tobit, and see the husband and wife have good times and bad times, rough times and easy times. Abraham and Sarah had good times and bad times.

Social welfare programs: food assistance, health care coverage, housing support for low-income populations. That is explaining verse 7: the instruments of the churl are evil, meant to destroy the family, devices to destroy the poor with lying words. Every time you vote, Democrat or Republican, you vote for the destruction of the black family, because nothing ever changes; no matter who’s in power, they are against the black family. The so-called conservative white woman understands she don’t have power without the white men in power, and she put up the people who told the liberal black woman to destroy her family, and she followed. Some of the sisters are starting to realize: we’ve been played for the past 50 years.

“But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.” We gave a list of several liberal things that society has used to destroy the black and brown community, our people, the Israelites.

The movie Claudine, from the 70s and relevant for today: she understood he was a blue-collar worker, a sanitation worker, a garbage man. The average black and Latin man is a blue-collar worker, but you hear sisters, he got to make six figures. When you get a six-figure man you get six-figure vices, and his appetite ain’t just for one; ask P Diddy. In the show where the women pop their balloons, he said nothing but his job title, garbage man, and they all popped. In Claudine he took her on with six kids, and each of those kids had problems he went in and tried to help with. Today a brother will marry a sister with one or two kids and it’s ‘don’t touch my kid, you ain’t the daddy.’ Stop being a damn fool: court, prove them first, especially if they got kids. And there are bum brothers that come into a sister’s life and destroy a family she was doing good with. Sister, you got to be able to smell a bum; a big beard don’t mean nothing.

“Rise up, ye women that are at ease”: the women have lived at ease on liberal things. She has benefited from all those things we just listed. That’s what the movie Claudine is about: those liberal things destroyed her family, and James Earl Jones’ character came in to undo all that. “Hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech”: give ear means listen to what God has to say. Verse 9 down is wake up, you women: you’ve been living a careless, carefree life in this society. Get yourself together.

“Many days and years shall ye be troubled”: God is prophesying to the women. “Ye careless women”: God is now calling you careless, because you’ve been careless in allowing your husbands to be put out the house, careless letting your children be raised by society, careless depending on liberal things. “For the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come”: women power, ‘we all going to get’ — no, that’s not going to be successful. That crap failed.

“Tremble, ye women that are at ease”: you better be scared, because God is going to bring some heat on you. “Be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins”: mourn, repent. That’s what he’s saying.

“They shall lament for the teats”: look up teats so you know I ain’t making it up. People say, oh, you’re just nasty; I am nasty, but that’s not why I said it. A teat is the nipple or raised part of the female mammal’s breast that allows milk to be drawn from an udder or breast for feeding young. Some of you women got breasts, some of you got udders.

They shall lament for the teats means for the children: the issues are with their kids, because they have neglected their children. That’s why in Titus the aged women were to teach the young women how to love their husbands and love their children, and that does not go on today. A video: a mother at Walmart with her two-year-old in nothing but a diaper in freezing weather, below 20 degrees, no shirt, socks or shoes. Older black women came to help, and all praise to the Lord the older women had some sense, and she cursed them out. That’s why you need grandmas. We are sick people. Brothers, some of those type of sisters are in here: before you marry her, wait, let her get this right, or she’ll be cursing you out and twerking.

“Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city”. All this happened in Jerusalem. But God’s judgment is like a ring: it goes around and around, and what happened in the past is happening again. There the women were depending on Rome and got jacked up; now here we are in America, families broken up, she’s depending on social services: ‘I don’t need a man, to hell with you, I can do bad all by myself.’ All this is going to happen.

“Because the palaces shall be forsaken”: our homes shall be forsaken. “The multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks”.

“Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high”: the only time it’s going to change is when the Lord sends that spirit from on high, and that comes through brothers teaching, sisters learning, and the sisters instructing the younger sisters and the children.
“Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.” Before we get to the kingdom we’re going to be in the wilderness. That’s what this is saying.

“And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation”: that’s what we want, to get up out of here and live in a peaceable habitation in New Jerusalem. “In sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places”: that’s New Jerusalem.
“Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass”: we’re going to be provided for, because of obeying the word of God, men and women.

precepts.why: Christ is the King; now the princes. “These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers”: the princes of the tribes of their fathers.

“The princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes”. Brothers, we are the princes the Bible is talking about. So when Isaiah 32:1 says a king shall reign and princes shall rule in judgment, the king is Christ and we are the princes.

“Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools”: our people in this society, just like in the time of Rome, professed themselves to be wise but became fools. “And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man”: we gave away the true living God, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. “And to birds, and fourfooted beasts”: believe it or not, these four-footed beasts represent religions.

Some people say I don’t believe in God, I believe in politics; that’s the only thing they believe in. There are black people the same way, the black caucus: they follow the Republicans, the elephant, or the Democrats, the jackass, the donkey. Those are the four-footed beasts, and these are religions people are in. That’s why Isaiah 32:5 says the vile person shall be no more called liberal.

God has been saying this for centuries. “As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” Every time you vote you’re watching: maybe the Democrats can save us, maybe the Republicans. You’re expecting your oppressor to come save you.

The white woman says, I’m standing by the white man, because when the white man has power the white woman has power. For some reason black women don’t think like that; she thinks she’s going to get power without her black man, and that ain’t reality. East Indian women say I’m standing by my East Indian man; Chinese people say I’m standing by my Chinese man. Only the black and Latin woman says, I don’t need you. She’s the only race that does that.

All this happened in Jerusalem, but remember what Paul said: the things written aforetime “were written for our learning”, that we through the scriptures “might have hope”. Why did he say that? Because God’s judgment is like a ring: it goes around and around, and what happened in the past is happening again. The women then were depending on Rome; the women now are depending on America and social services.

sense.text:
Saddam Hussein, to the Arab leaders: what’s the meaning of Israel killing Arabs every day on TV, and the harshest statements that came out were denunciations? Draw your sword out. Look how many Arab titles there are, presidents and kings, and five lunatics kill our people in Palestine. It’s embarrassing for someone to say he is the leader of his people when he can’t carry a sword against oppression. I’m not saying I support Saddam Hussein’s policies, but you got to be able to discern right from wrong and see what pertains to us. What does that got to do with us? Everything. We got soldiers, officers, captains, deacons and Bishops, and it’s a shame if you cannot lift a sword against oppression. Our sword is the Bible.

“For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword”: that’s our sword, and our sword must be lifted against oppression. We see oppression, we got to pull the sword, pull the scriptures. “Piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit”: sometimes you got to hurt somebody’s feelings. “And of the joints and marrow”: that comes later. “And is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart”: the Bible will reveal the thoughts and intents of somebody’s heart. Just bring the scriptures out and let the word of God do what it do.

That’s why, brothers, we travel to these different places, countries and lands: because our people are suffering oppression. Our job is to go to these places with the word of God, the sword, and lift the sword against oppression. There are good days and there are bad days when things don’t go the way you want, but that’s what we signed up for.

Saddam was getting on his men at the table face to face, kings and presidents. “Neither let me give flattering titles unto man”: a flattering title is an undeserved title. He told them, in this room you got all these different titles and you say you’re all leaders, but what are you doing for the people? We need to take that for ourselves. We got this title and that title; what are we really doing? Some brothers come in this truth just for a rank, and you are not even fulfilling that role. Captains over you are being lenient: we put him there, but he’s doing the work of a soldier, he got all kind of excuses. Your family is in disarray, falling apart, you need counsel every week, we give the same scripture, she ain’t listening, you ain’t doing what you got to do at home, but you say you’re a leader. Stop it. That’s what Saddam Hussein was saying on a higher level.

A title without actions is nothing but flattery. Soldiers, officers, captains, deacons, Bishops, leaders of the people: if we’re not fulfilling the roles the scripture says we must fulfill, what are you doing? Some brothers have been with us for many years, nine to eleven years, and have not traveled outside the city limits, don’t even have a passport. I’m not talking about somebody with some criminal thing going; I’m talking about you’re able, but you just ain’t willing. He says I don’t have no money, but you’re able to pay your bills. Some of these brothers are not with us.
“For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.” God will kill you.

Saddam was getting on the Arab leaders about trying to set up an international thing with America. “Shall the throne of iniquity”: that’s America, these world governments. “Have fellowship with thee”: have fellowship with the Lord? “Which frameth mischief by a law”: they create laws to destroy us. And notice their laws don’t work for them: the international court said Netanyahu is a war criminal, and America said that’s BS, to hell with that, you’re not going to do nothing. Another man came out and said that court was set up for the dark nations, not for European countries; when it gets to white folks, they’re above it.

They don’t respect their own laws. Before they went into Iraq the so-called UN, supposed to be the peacemaker, said don’t go, and America said to hell with you, you’re just my little puppet; then after the war, guess who was cleaning up in Iraq. Four hundred-some treaties with the natives and they kept none of it. You’re dealing with a man who don’t have no conscience: it’s the devil the Bible speaks of. For the fourth time America voted against a ceasefire in Gaza, where there are Afro-Palestinians, our people, and more than half of those 50,000 dead are women and children. The ICC put out a warrant for Netanyahu and America says we do not recognize it, the same America that pushed it for Putin. The most evil hypocrisy in the world, all of it under ‘human rights’ and ‘democracy’, which they made up to keep the black nation under them. We’ve been teaching for years this place is the devil, and since you don’t want to listen to black folks, the Lord is showing you on TV.

The Times of Israel: the former Mossad chief, Yossi Cohen, stalked and intimidated the former ICC chief prosecutor Fatou Bensouda between 2017 and 2021, and hinted he’d incriminate her husband. If any of us threatens a judge, we go to jail for a long time. He threatened this black woman and her husband, and nothing happened, because she’s black; it doesn’t matter what title she holds. When you look at evil things like that, you know what the scripture is saying is true.

Saddam said the Arabs have to wake up, stop accepting humiliation from America and the Zionists: the oppression against our people in Palestine is oppression against us all. That’s the mentality. We’re telling the black man and the Latin man it’s time to wake up. Our people don’t see that. When a Chinese man got beat up on a plane, all of China threatened the airline and said we won’t ride your planes; they gave him free flights for the rest of his life and the white man had to apologize. With us nobody stands; it’s always, well, maybe if you didn’t do it this way.

Watch the prophecy. “Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen”: among the nations. What is he going to say? “Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.” God is saying there’s going to be a leader charismatic enough to rally all the nations against the white man. Saddam Hussein thought he was it, but the Lord said no, he’s not it.
“Dedan, and Tema, and Buz”: write this down, Arabs. “And all that are in the utmost corners”.
“And all the kings of Arabia”: this is talking about the Arab nations. “And all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert”: they were mingled with Keturah’s sons too.
“All the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes”: Elam and the Medes is Iran, Pakistan and India. Write that down.

“And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another”: that’s NATO. “And all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.” Sheshach, write this down: the United States of America. That’s a metaphor for them; Sheshach is Babylon.
“Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall”: talking about America. “And rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.” Judgment is coming.

Saddam Hussein said oppression against Palestine is oppression against all Arabs, and we’re telling you, men and women, oppression against one of us is oppression against all of us. “And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it”: all of us suffer with it. “Or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.” That’s called unity, that’s called having one mind.

That’s so difficult for black people: ‘I do me, that’s you.’ Your mindset is wrong; you can never be a leader thinking like that. One for all and all for one: that comes from the Bible. Saddam said it’s against every one of us, against every Arab, and humiliating for every Arab that accepts it. That’s how a leader thinks; that’s leadership.

Saddam said, we don’t care about appearances, we care about results. That hit the bomb. To hell with appearances; we want to see results, brothers and sisters, and God wants to see results. “Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.” God says I don’t care about your appearances: you got a form of godliness, but when it comes down to the nitty-gritty you ain’t in the battle, you ain’t really in this fight, you ain’t really obedient. What about the results? What are you doing? What he was saying to them, the Bible is saying to us. Let that marinate, meditate on that.

Saddam said, since when were big goals achieved without losses and sacrifices? I’m going to get to us in a minute; first the Arabs. “The burden of the desert of the sea”: the desert of the sea is the desert nations, that’s the Arabs. “So it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.”

“The treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously”: that’s America and Israel, both of them; they are the treacherous dealer. “Go up, O Elam”: that’s Iran. “Besiege, O Media”: that includes Pakistan and India. “All the sighing thereof have I made to cease”: because of oppression.

“I was bowed down at the hearing of it”: hearing the destruction he was bowed down. “I was dismayed at the seeing of it”: dismayed at seeing the destruction. “My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me”: because of what the prophet Isaiah saw, he was scared.
“Arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield”: that means prepare for war.
“Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.” God says to Isaiah, one of your students, one of these young men, set him up as a watchman; I want him to tell you what he sees.
“He saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen”: how much is a couple? Two.
“And he cried, A lion”: he cried like a lion, exalting his voice.

“And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen.” This is the prophet telling Isaiah what he sees, and this is after the destruction. “Babylon is fallen, is fallen”: he sees the fall of Babylon the great.
“That which I have heard of the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you”: all that God told me, I saw it, and I’m telling it to you.

“The burden of Dumah”: that’s Ishmael. Write it down: Dumah was one of the sons of Ishmael, that’s the Arabs. “He calleth to me out of Seir”: Seir was Edom, but the prophet ain’t in the land of Edom. The prophets are here.
“The burden upon Arabia”: the burden of the Arab nations. “O ye travelling companies of Dedanim”: those are Keturah’s kids.

“The inhabitants of the land of Tema”: that’s Ishmael. They “brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled”: they prevented him from dying. Remember verse 9, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, and verse 11, watchman, what of the night: he sees the remnants of the Arabs coming back from war after America is destroyed, after the state of Israel is wiped out, a small remnant of Arabs running through the desert.
“For they fled from the swords”: they fled from the missiles. “From the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.” These were the ones that escaped from the war.

“Within a year, according to the years of an hireling”: the years of an hireling is a limited time, a short time. “And all the glory of Kedar shall fail”: all the glory of the Arabs shall fail. You see Dubai, how beautiful that place is: ski resorts in the desert, underwater hotels, glorious, the best place in the world right now. All that glory is gone.

“And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished”: their numbers are going to dwindle down to nothing. “For the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it”: that’s what the Lord prophesied.

precepts.why:
This explains anoint the shield. “Make bright the arrows; gather the shields”: make bright your missiles, and gather your shields, your defense system. “The Lord hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes”: the Medes again, still going with Iran. “For his device is against Babylon, to destroy it”: God’s device, his purpose, is to destroy Babylon the great, the United States of America. That’s his plan. “Because it is the vengeance of the Lord, the vengeance of his temple”: God is going to bring vengeance on this white man.

That’s why they don’t know what Iran has: the Lord is raising up Iran to fight that damn devil.

The Arabs will suffer loss. “Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots”: we’re reading about the Arabs. “And the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble”: the Arabs will strike first, the Bible prophesies.

“Also the Carmanians”: the Iranians. Iran will join the Arabs according to prophecy, “raging in wrath” “as the wild boars of the wood”, “and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians”: the land of the Assyrians is modern-day Israel, the state of Israel. They’re going to destroy a portion of that land.

“And then shall the dragons have the upper hand”: the Arabs will have the upper hand, “remembering their nature”: they’re going to remember their nature from Genesis. “If they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to persecute them”: they’re going to work together to persecute the state of Israel. Then “keep silence through their power”: Iran. “And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them, and consume some of them”: some of the Arabs, some of the Iranians, are going to get put to death, “and in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.”

Isaiah’s watchman saw the fall of Babylon the great; that’s the same thing. “And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen”. You know why it says it two times? Because not only is this place going, but little Babylon over there, the state of Israel, is going too. They’re going to get wiped out.

sense.text:
This is the history of what America did with Saddam Hussein. America at one time helped Saddam Hussein with a coup, gave him money, intelligence, battle planning; they worked together. Then when Saddam Hussein said, we don’t need America, America’s corrupt, we Arabs can do our own thing, America said no, we had a deal.

This is talking about the Roman Republic, not the Roman Empire: two different groups. “Whom they would help to a kingdom, those reign; and whom again they would, they displace.” What is that called? A coup. They help you to become president, and when they don’t like you they take you down. That’s why you got to pay attention to the news: Africa has a coup almost every two months, you see it every other week.

That’s what happened with Saddam Hussein. They set him up as president, then they got tired of him and wanted to take him down, and that’s why George Bush said he has weapons of mass destruction, and it was all a lie. When Saddam tried to unite all the Arabs and said we need to wipe Israel out, because if they’re killing the Palestinians we’re going to be next, they said we got to get rid of this guy. And when he was executed, some celebrated in the streets: these are the groups they call the rebels. America and Israel find about a hundred people, give each maybe $50,000 to $100,000 to overthrow the man they don’t like, and that’s who you see in the streets. That’s how America rolls, like John Perkins wrote in Diary of an Economic Hitman. That’s what Rome was doing.

The same with Gaddafi. There was a time the CIA and Britain’s MI6 worked with Gaddafi too. But Gaddafi wanted to unite the African nations off a gold-based currency, less reliant on the US dollar, so the CIA trained a US citizen to overthrow him: that’s what we read in first Maccabees, that’s what they do. Appoint puppets: that’s coups. Gaddafi did for Libyans what no black leader does for you: free electricity, loans at 0% interest, a home as a human right, money to newlyweds and to mothers, free education and medicine. Everybody says he was evil; he was helping his people. He didn’t die, he was murdered by rebel fighters: pay this group 20K, 50K, kill him. They work with a man, and when he no longer serves them they sell him out and hang him. The white man has no friends; his friend is himself, his money, his pockets.

Under Obama and Hillary Clinton all that chaos broke loose in the Middle East; Hillary laughed, ‘we came, we saw, he died’. This is talking about Edom. Verse 2 says “set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”: mount Seir is the white man, and it is America.

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel”: God is saying they have that hatred for the children of Israel, us. “In the time that their iniquity had an end”: our iniquity had an end when we got released from slavery.

“I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.” Y’all don’t see all the genocidal killing this white man is doing? God says you have not hated blood, and because of that blood shall pursue this so-called white man.
“I will fill his mountains with his slain men”: God said, I’m going to make sure a lot of them die, in the hills, the valleys and the rivers.
“I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”: there’s going to be no comeback for America.

“Thou” is Seir, which is Esau, Edom. “These two nations” are Judah and Israel, the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom. “And these two countries”: write this down, that’s Israel and America. The white man took both: one group took Israel as Jewish, the next group took America as Christian. “Whereas the Lord was there”: the Lord was with us.

“I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them.” The same anger they had on us in the land of Israel, the same anger they had on us here in America, God said I’m going to use that same anger on you. This nation, these people, have an envy and anger against us. That’s why there’s no reaching the conscience of the white man; they got no conscience towards us. You cannot hug them. Israelites that know the truth, on YouTube, wanting hugs from the white man: you simple as hell.

“I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee”: I will make myself known among the Israelites. When God destroys Esau, everybody is going to honor the Lord, and everybody is going to know that we are the chosen people.

What’s their blasphemy? “They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.” They took Israel and said it’s given to us; they came to America and said Manifest Destiny, it is given to us by God. Y’all remember that from history class. “I have heard them”: God said I heard all your blasphemies.
“When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate”: that’s peace and safety, then sudden destruction.

“As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate”: they rejoice at our fall. That’s what Christmas is about, that’s what Thanksgiving is about: our destruction. “So will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it.”

precepts.why: Our iniquity had an end when we came out of slavery, but the heathen “helped forward the affliction” on us. That’s when Jim Crow came, the KKK came, all kind of evil came on us, in the very time Ezekiel says Edom shed our blood after our iniquity had an end.

sense.text:
People want to know how bad it was: Trump said Libya was better with Gaddafi than without him. In Libya they are selling black people. A man from Cameroon was sold four times, a slave to a whole neighborhood; they are more violent with the darkest migrants, black skin is a commodity there, sold cheap like chickens, a pregnant woman sold. And y’all think slavery is over? Where was the UN, supposed to be a peacemaker? Where was America? How come the black Muslims don’t talk about this? As long as one of us is a captive, none of us are free. That’s the mentality we got to have.

We read Deuteronomy 28 and say, oh yeah, that was back then. No, brothers, it’s still going on today. “Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.” You think that ended already? It’s still going on in Libya today, and not just Libya: in different parts of Arabia, Afghanistan. It’s under the radar, but it’s still going on. North Africa, all across the top, where Libya is: the Arabs took that over, and that’s where slavery is going on.

We have isolated ourselves to think about just here in America. You better think outside the box and see what’s going on on the other side of the world to our people. So y’all get your mind right.

We talked about our sister Assata Shakur, about Saddam Hussein, even Gaddafi, but remember: ours is the true revolution. The Most High gave us the Bible to do three things. Write this down: increase our knowledge, change our lives, and gather the 12 tribes of Israel.

The first is to increase our knowledge. This is talking about Moses: “He made him to hear his voice, and brought him into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments before his face, even the law of life and knowledge, that he might teach Jacob his covenants, and Israel his judgments.” That he might teach us his covenants, and the Israelites his judgments.

The second thing is to change our lives. The Bible is given to us to change, to transform, not to stay as products of this American system as Negroes.

“And be not conformed to this world”: this world says that you’re African American; no, don’t be conformed to that. This world says the black woman don’t need the black man; no, do not conform to that. “But be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind”: that’s where the true transformation begins, in our minds. “That ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.”

The third thing is to gather the 12 tribes, because with all this knowledge and this transformation, what good is it if we don’t raise up our people?

“It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob”: to be the servant of God we must raise up the tribes of Jacob. “And to restore the preserved of Israel”: that’s the elect, that’s what we’re looking for. “I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles”: the light to the Gentiles is the northern kingdom.

precepts.why: How do we know the light to the Gentiles is talking about the northern kingdom? It’s in Isaiah 9, but here it is in the New Testament: “The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles; The people which sat in darkness saw great light”. Zebulon and Naphtali saw great light: that’s the great light Isaiah 49 is talking about. The Gentiles is our people.

sense.text:
There’s no revolution, brothers and sisters, without bloodshed. That might scare some of you, but this is war. You think this white man murdered millions of our people and is going to stand by and let a group of what he calls Negroes jump up and overthrow everything? He’s not going to let that happen.

“Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.” Paul was getting on the Hebrews: y’all ain’t doing the work. Remember Paul was stoned, whipped, beaten; these are the things that occur when you go out and teach. Sisters, you take it for granted when your man goes out and teaches: he might not come home. Oh, you just teaching the Bible? You don’t understand: violence comes with teaching the Bible.

precepts.why: “I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.” When you come into this truth, like you men and women in here, you got to be willing to sacrifice for this truth. You think it just means I give up my job? It ain’t about your job. It means exactly what it says: in your life, be willing to become a living sacrifice. That’s your reasonable service.

sense.text:
They never taught this in Sunday school; Sunday school is a joke, they don’t know what the Bible’s about. “What I tell you in darkness”: what I tell you in parables and dark sayings, “that speak ye in light”. “What ye hear in the ear”, what you hear in secret, “that preach ye upon the housetops”. All the parables we’re learning, the dark sayings, Christ is instructing us to make plain to the people. That’s speaking in the light and on the rooftop.

People don’t know who 666 is. It says it’s the number of a man: what man? The white man. Christ said the abomination of desolation shall stand in the holy place: who’s the abomination of desolation? That was Rome, the white man. Make it plain, and guess what, people get mad: how dare you speak against the white man, look at all the good he did. In Papua New Guinea a dude said we must give all praise to the white man because without him some of us would still be cannibals. We had to curse that dude out.

“And fear not them which kill the body”: because when you speak plain it’s going to piss people off, your mama, your fathers, your kids. “But are not able to kill the soul”: they cannot kill the real you. “But rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.” Hell there is the lake of fire. When all the missiles hit it’s literally going to be a lake of fire, and in that there’s going to be a spirit realm, and people are going to burn. You got groups now saying there ain’t no hell, ain’t no lake of fire. The Bible says there’s a lake of fire. Stop being dumb.

“Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.” Christ is telling us, don’t worry about death: nobody dies without the Father’s consent. A bird don’t die unless the Father says so. “But the very hairs of your head are all numbered”: that’s how important you are. “Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.”

“Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.” Go back to verse 28: he’s talking about the stress and fear of dying, of being killed. He ain’t talking about going to your job and saying yes, I’m an Israelite; it’s deeper than that. When you’re in fear of dying, will you still confess the Lord? “But whosoever shall deny me before men”: sometimes fear comes over you, I don’t know him, I never believed that Israelite crap, give me Christmas, give me a pork chop. “Him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.”

“I came not to send peace, but a sword”: that’s war. “For I am come to set a man at variance against his father”: some of your fathers don’t believe this truth, they don’t believe in the Son of God. “And the daughter against her mother”: some of the daughters will not agree with the Son of God and will be against the mother; some of the daughters-in-law will be against the mothers-in-law. “And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household”: the first enemies you’re going to have, Christ is saying, are in your own house. That’s why a man that knows not how to guide his own house cannot guide the church: it starts at home, not on the street.

“He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me”: you love your rebellious mother and father more than the Son of God, you’re not worthy of the Lord. “And he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me”: you love your rebellious son or daughter more than the Lord, you’re not worthy of him.
“And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.” The cross is a symbol of death. Take your death: that’s what he’s telling all of us, be willing to take your death.
“He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.” Pay attention to this: you’re going to lose your life.

precepts.why:
This is the old man Eleazar. The Greeks told him, we know you don’t eat unclean food, so get some clean food and make believe it’s pork so all the people can see you. He answered: “And so they through mine hypocrisy, and desire to live a little time and a moment longer, should be deceived by me, and I get a stain to mine old age, and make it abominable.” “Desire to live a little time”: that’s you trying to save your life in this world. He was 90 years old, and he said, you want me to be a hypocrite and deceive the people only so I could live a little longer?

Some of you, the white man will say, go against Christ, go against these laws, these commandments, and you can live. That’s what Revelation 13 is talking about. Some of you are going to want to live another five years, so you give up the Lord for five years. Five years as opposed to eternal life? You stupid.

“For though for the present time I should be delivered from the punishment of men: yet should I not escape the hand of the Almighty, neither alive, nor dead.” That’s what Christ said in Matthew 10:28: “fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.” The Bible is saying the same thing, brothers and sisters.

sense.text: Some of you might say, I don’t care about the wars; these wars in other countries have nothing to do with us. Brothers, the wars in other countries have everything to do with us. “For the sword and their destruction draweth nigh, and one people shall stand up and fight against another”: this is war.

“There shall be sedition among men, and invading one another”: nations will invade one another. “A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able. For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled, the houses shall be destroyed, and men shall be afraid.”

“But shall destroy their houses with the sword”: you can’t destroy a house with a sword, so what is this sword, brothers? Missiles. “And spoil their goods”: rob you, “because of the lack of bread, and for great tribulation.” The great tribulation is coming.

“Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me”: God said, I’m calling all the kings of the earth to reverence me, “from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus”: that’s Lebanon. “To turn themselves one against another”: God is going to make all these nations fight against each other. “And repay the things that they have done to them”: the them is the Israelites; the next verse tells you that.

“Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom.” All the wars have to do with our deliverance. Every war, every skirmish is about our deliverance. So you’d be very foolish to ignore what’s going on in the world when the Bible says I’m letting all this happen to deliver you.

The president of Syria said on television there is no evidence 6 million Jews were killed in the Holocaust, that it was politicized to prepare the transfer of the Jews from Europe to Palestine, and that the Jews who came to Palestine are Khazar Jews from east of the Caspian Sea, pagans who converted to Judaism in the 8th century, with nothing whatsoever to do with the ancient people of Israel. And just yesterday armed rebels attacked Assad and advanced into Aleppo. Rebels who hate Assad: it’s the same pattern, brothers. Iraq, Libya, and now Syria. It’s the same propaganda they use on Assata Shakur, oh she was a criminal; shut the hell up. They took that same COINTELPRO and advanced it to national and global means.

So what does God say about Syria? “Woe be unto thee, Babylon, and Asia! woe be unto thee, Egypt and Syria!” Woe means destruction.
“Bewail your children, and be sorry; for your destruction is at hand”: cry for your children. God says these countries are going to get wiped out.

“A sword is sent upon you, and who may turn it back? A fire is sent among you, and who may quench it? Plagues are sent unto you, and what is he that may drive them away?” God is saying, when I bring war and destruction on these nations nobody can stop it. All your voting can’t stop it; the right president in the seat can’t stop it.

precepts.why:
Write this down: here’s the precept for Syria. “Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman”: this is about the white man. “Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”: the least of the flock is the Israelis, the state of Israel. They’re going to be the cause of this third world war, the cause of Armageddon coming, and thank God for that.

“The earth is moved at the noise of their fall”: didn’t we read that earlier in Isaiah about their fall, Babylon is fallen, is fallen? It’s talking about the same event. “At the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea”: because that’s where all the navies are, at the Red Sea, even to this day. “Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle”: this white man is going to come as a savior, “and spread his wings over Bozrah”: that’s Jordan. “And at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs”: it’s going to be fear all around.

“Concerning Damascus”: Damascus is the capital city of Syria. “Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea”: that goes back to the Red Sea in verse 21. “It cannot be quiet”: everybody is going to hear about the fall of Babylon. “Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee”: she’s going to run; remember we read about the Arabs dying in the desert.

“How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!” That’s the land of Israel: the people there are going to get wiped out, and it’s going to be a miracle that the land is still there. “All the men of war shall be cut off in that day”. “And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben–hadad”: there’s going to be destruction throughout the land of Syria.

sense.text:
What President al-Assad said was absolutely correct: those are not the Jews, not the Israelites; they have nothing to do with the ancient Israelites of the Bible. People say Assad is so evil. Why is he so evil? Because he speaks against those fake Israelis.

“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”: we rich. “And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not”: that’s blasphemy, when they say they’re Jews, because they’re not. And they are pissed off that President Assad of Syria brought it out on national television. “But are the synagogue of Satan”: they are the devil the Bible speaks of. That’s what God says, that’s what the King of Kings says.

There’s going to be judgment on all nations, brothers and sisters. So don’t think we on the Arab side; we ain’t on Syria’s side, we ain’t on Egypt’s side, and we ain’t on America’s side. We on God’s side. “He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.”

precepts.why: “Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured”: every nation that put their hands on us is going to be devoured. “And all thine adversaries, every one of them”: all our enemies, every one of them, nobody’s going to get left out, “shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee”, that robbed us, destroyed us, “shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.” Those nations are going to be our prey.

sense.text: “The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee”: they’re going to bend the knee. “And all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet”. We’re waiting for this glorious day right here; I don’t know about y’all, but I’m waiting for this day. “And they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel”: they’re going to call us that.
“And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks”: slaves. “And the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers”: slaves.

“But ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord”: we’re going to be named the priests of the Lord, “men shall call you the Ministers of our God”. “Ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles”: we’re going to take all their riches, because their riches is our riches. “And in their glory shall ye boast yourselves”: we’re going to brag; that’s what it means to boast.

“For your shame ye shall have double”: all the shame we caught, the hell in this land, we’re going to get double for that. “And for confusion”: all the stupidity they put on our minds. “They shall rejoice in their portion”: we’re going to rejoice in our portion. “Therefore in their land they shall possess the double”: we’re going to get the double. “Everlasting joy shall be unto them.”
“For I the Lord love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering”: God said I hate robbery. “And I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.”

“And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles”: our children shall be known; all the nations are going to know our children by name. “And their offspring among the people”: everybody is going to know our children and move the hell out their way. “All that see them shall acknowledge them”: that’s the son and daughter of the priests, “that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.” 12 tribes.
